changelog: **SaleVali publishes its price list** (#2767). New dependency-free `src/lib/marketingPlans.ts` (deliberately apart from `plans.ts`, whose plans drive subscriptions, entitlements and the meter): Team €149 / Business €249 / Enterprise €390 per user per month billed annually (monthly €179 / €299 / annual only), minimum 3 / 5 / 10 users, onboarding none / €2,900 / €6,900, all net. `/pricing` on the marketing host renders it as three cards (`pricing-marketing-plans`, `mkt-plan-<key>`) with a "Talk to us" link to the landing demo form; the internship price model stays hidden there. The Pricing entry is back in the marketing header and footer, and the marketing landing FAQ quotes the "from" price via `marketingFromSeatEur()`. Unit test `scripts/test/marketing-plans.test.mjs`; `e2e/host-vertical-public-pages.spec.ts` now asserts the published list instead of its absence.

en: SaleVali now has a published price list: three plans for sales teams, billed per user, on the pricing page.
tr: SaleVali'nin artık yayımlanmış bir fiyat listesi var: fiyatlandırma sayfasında, kullanıcı başına faturalanan üç satış ekibi paketi.
de: SaleVali hat jetzt eine veröffentlichte Preisliste: drei Pläne für Vertriebsteams, abgerechnet pro Nutzer, auf der Preisseite.
